title: Data-to-Energy Stochastic Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2509.26364v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The Schr\"odinger bridge problem is concerned with finding a stochastic dynamical system bridging two marginal distributions that minimises a certain transportation cost. This problem, which represents a generalisation of optimal transport to the stochastic case, has received attention due to its connections to diffusion models and flow matching, as well as its applications in the natural sciences. However, all existing algorithms allow to infer such dynamics only for cases where samples from both distributions are available. In this paper, we propose the first general method for modelling Schr\"odinger bridges when one (or both) distributions are given by their unnormalised densities, with no access to data samples. Our algorithm relies on a generalisation of the iterative proportional fitting (IPF) procedure to the data-free case, inspired by recent developments in off-policy reinforcement learning for training of diffusion sampler

translated_title: 数据到能量的随机动力学
translated_abstract: 薛定谔桥问题旨在寻找一个连接两个边缘分布并使某种运输成本最小化的随机动力学系统。该问题是最优传输向随机情形的推广，因其与扩散模型和流匹配的联系以及在自然科学中的应用而受到关注。然而，所有现有算法仅能在两个分布的样本均可获得的情况下推断此类动力学。在本文中，我们提出了首个通用方法，用于在一个（或两个）分布仅由其未归一化密度给出、无法访问数据样本的情况下建模薛定谔桥。我们的算法依赖于将迭代比例拟合（IPF）程序推广到无数据情形，其灵感来自近期在用于训练扩散采样器的离策略强化学习方面的发展。
tldr: 本文提出了首个当分布仅由未归一化密度给出而无数据样本时建模薛定谔桥的通用方法，通过受离策略强化学习启发的无数据版迭代比例拟合（IPF）算法实现。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the first general method for modelling Schrödinger bridges when one or both distributions are given only by unnormalised densities without access to data samples, relying on a data-free generalisation of the iterative proportional fitting (IPF) procedure inspired by off-policy reinforcement learning for diffusion samplers.
